# Support for TypEmoji

Welcome to the TypEmoji community! We are committed to making TypEmoji the fastest, most reliable emoji and symbol typing experience on Linux.

If you have questions, need help troubleshooting, or want to contribute, here is how to get the support you need.

---

## 💬 Where to Ask Questions

For questions, troubleshooting, setup guidance, or configuration ideas, please use our **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Ayan-Jain-737/TypEmoji/discussions)** board.

- **[Q&A](https://github.com/Ayan-Jain-737/TypEmoji/discussions/categories/q-a)**: Ask questions about configuring global shortcuts, setting up Wayland compositors (Hyprland, Sway, GNOME, KDE), or managing emoji fonts.
- **[Ideas & Feedback](https://github.com/Ayan-Jain-737/TypEmoji/discussions/categories/ideas)**: Propose and discuss potential features before opening formal issues.
- **[Show & Tell](https://github.com/Ayan-Jain-737/TypEmoji/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)**: Share your desktop configurations, keybindings, and custom setups.

Please reserve **[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Ayan-Jain-737/TypEmoji/issues)** for verifiable bug reports and actionable feature requests.

---

## 🐛 Reporting Bugs

If you encounter unexpected behavior, crashes, or typing injection issues:

1. Search the **[existing issues](https://github.com/Ayan-Jain-737/TypEmoji/issues)** to see if the problem has already been reported.
2. If not, open a new issue using our **[Bug Report Form](https://github.com/Ayan-Jain-737/TypEmoji/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)**.
3. Be sure to include your Linux distribution, compositor (GNOME, KDE, Sway, Hyprland, etc.), display server (Wayland/X11), and terminal output or logs from `EmojiTyper --show` or `/tmp/emojityper.log`.

---

## 🔒 Security Vulnerability Reporting

The TypEmoji team takes security seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability (such as unintended IPC manipulation, privilege escalation, or clipboard leakage):

- **Please DO NOT report security issues via public GitHub issues.**
- Instead, submit a report via **[GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/Ayan-Jain-737/TypEmoji/security/advisories/new)**.
- If private reporting is unavailable, contact the project maintainer directly via email listed on the maintainer profile.
- You will receive an initial response within 24 hours acknowledging the report, followed by a status update once triage and remediation are underway.

---

## ⏱️ Maintainer Response SLA Pledge

We value your time and contributions. The maintainers of TypEmoji make the following pledge:

> **Maintainer SLA Pledge**:
> Every new issue, pull request, and GitHub discussion post will receive an initial triage review and response within **24 hours**.

Whether you are filing a bug report, submitting a patch, or asking a setup question, our goal is to maintain a responsive, dependable, and friendly environment for all Linux users.
